name: L-Train x 5 Infused Prerolls | Lemon Venom
description:
Dive into the invigorating taste of Lemon Venom with our Atomik Dogwalker blunt 5-Pack. Infused externally with live resin and kief, each mini blunt offers a smooth, citrusy flavor that uplifts your senses.

Crafted from a premium (all flower) blend, these blunts provide a refreshing experience with every puff. Perfect for those moments when you need a burst of refreshment and relaxation.
